ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

15. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.

19. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)

   B. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.

22. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers
